description: Header file defining the PythonFunction interface for autograd in PyTorch, including the PyNode structure and THPFunction class, with external references to Python and autograd components.

classes.name: PyNode
classes.description: A structure representing a Python-implemented autograd node, wrapping a Python object and providing methods for autograd operations.

classes.name: THPFunction
classes.description: A struct representing a Python-defined autograd function, including saved tensors, configuration flags, and associated Python objects.

methods.name: to_py_args
methods.description: Converts input variables to Python arguments.

methods.name: to_variable_list
methods.description: Converts a Python object to a list of variables.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the autograd function to input variables.

methods.name: apply_with_saved_impl
methods.description: Applies the function with saved variables.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the node.

methods.name: is_traceable
methods.description: Indicates if the node is traceable.

methods.name: is_aot_backward
methods.description: Checks if the node is for ahead-of-time backward.

methods.name: apply_with_saved
methods.description: Applies the function with saved variables.
